title: Title Page and Dedication
author: Johannes Kepler
full_title: Nova stereometria doliorum vinariorum, inprimis Austriaci, figurae omnium aptissimae; et usus in eo virgae cubicae compendiosissimus et plane singularis. Accessit stereometriae Archimedeae supplementum
source: The title page of the first edition of Kepler's *Nova stereometria doliorum vinariorum* (Linz: Johannes Planck, at the author's expense, 1615), and his dedication to Maximilian of Liechtenstein and Helmhard Jörger, dated at Linz, 17 December 1613.
transcribed_from: the [page images](https://doi.org/10.3931/e-rara-11051) of the copy in the ETH-Bibliothek, Zürich (Rar 356: 1 q), on e-rara.
summary: Kepler tells how, a newly married man laying in wine at Linz in the autumn of 1613, he watched the seller gauge every cask with a single slanting rod, whatever its shape, and set out to find whether the method had any geometrical foundation. He offers the result as a New Year's gift to two Austrian noblemen with large vineyards.

notes.note: Kepler married Susanna Reuttinger, his second wife, at Eferding on 30 October 1613.

notes.on: I had brought a new bride home
